log_level.description: Logging verbosity (debug, info, warn, error, critical)

run_dir.description: Directory for runtime files (e.g., Unix sockets)

default_subflow_timeout.description: Seconds after which an unused subflow is removed

auto_create_subflows.description: Enable automatic creation of subflows for new MPTCP connections

address_auto_add.description: Automatically announce local addresses to peers via MPTCP DUMP

address_auto_delete.description: Automatically withdraw local addresses when they disappear from the system

allowed_interfaces.description: List of network interface names allowed to carry MPTCP subflows (leave empty to allow all)

blocked_interfaces.description: List of network interface names explicitly disallowed for MPTCP subflows (e.g., loopback, cellular)

address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the endpoint (e.g., 192.168.1.10, fd00::1)

port.description: Optional port number for the endpoint

interface.description: Optional interface name bound to this endpoint

priority.description: Priority (1–255); higher values preferred for primary subflows

backup.description: Mark this endpoint as backup capacity

max_subflows.description: Maximum number of concurrent subflows per MPTCP connection

token_max.description: Maximum number of MPTCP tokens (connections × subflows)
